content:
A short video shared by a leaker with a reasonable track record appears to show two new iPhone 18 Pro colours on display in a retail store.

The brief clip shows what we'd expect in deep cherry and blue, but is almost certainly a fake…

The 14-second video shows someone holding a deep cherry iPhone 18 Pro Max, with a deep blue iPhone 17 Pro Max sitting next to it for comparison. We can also see a light blue model sitting on a stand.

The environment looks like a retail store. Macworld thinks it could be real.

I, however, am far more sceptical.

My colleague Fernando Silva was recently at the IFA trade show, and he said every single case manufacturer there had dummy units that look and feel nearly identical to the real thing, so getting hold of one of these models would be easy. The environment also looks suspect to me. The display table is far too small for a store, the product labels appear carelessly placed at odd angles, and there's no convincing store fit-out visible in the background.

Finally, while the leaker did have a decent track record in the past, they're recently just aggregating posts from Chinese social media.
